sentences.text:
Saj Food Products Private Limited vs The State Of West Bengal
& Ors on 5 March, 2025

Item No.17
 In The High Court At Calcutta

Subrata Constitutional Writ Jurisdiction
Bhattacharyya Appellate Side
 Ar(C)
 Wpa No.1908 of 2025
 Saj Food Products Private Limited
 -vs-
 The State of West Bengal & Ors.
 Mr. Abhratosh Majumdar, sr. adv.
 Mr. Sayan Sinha
 Mr. Nilanjan Bhattacharya
 Mr. K. Roy.
 Mr. Adil Naser
 Mr. K. Roy ... for the petitioner
 Mr. Biswabrata Basu Mallick
 Ms. Parna Roy Chowdhury ... for the State
 Mr. Arijit Majumdar ...for the Union of India
 Mr. Amit Mehra
 Ms. Pramita Banerjee
 Mr. Rohan Raj ... for the respondent nos. 3 and 4
1.

Perused the affidavit filed on behalf of the fourth and fifth respondents which clearly mentions that the parameters in the biscuit are within the limits prescribed in the Food Safety and Standards regulations.

The additive 'tartrazine' is permitted to be added in the food products, such as 'cake,
cookies, biscuit, cracker and pies'.

2. In view of the opinion placed before this Court by the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India, the subject food product, Top Herbs biscuit, of the petitioner shall be treated as safe for consumption and permitted to be sold in the open market.

entities.text: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
3. The impugned prohibitory order under section 36(3)(B) of the Food Safety and Standards Act,
2006 dated January 10, 2025 issued by the designated officer (FSSAI) & DFSIO, Murshidabad (Annexure P4, p.95) is set aside.
4. Learned senior advocate representing the petitioner submits that enough harassment and financial loss has been caused to the petitioner because of the issuance of the prohibitory order.
